topic: 近一年鱼眼镜头在具身领域的应用
notes: Scoping review of fisheye/panoramic/wide-FoV camera applications in embodied AI over one year (2025-09-09..2026-09-09). arXiv API was rate-limited throughout, so discovery ran through OpenAlex semantic search plus targeted WebSearch with a dynamic fisheye-term expansion file: 39 retrieval batches registered 119 candidates; 51 papers screened in as relevant; 51 full texts recovered non-OCR (7 direct PDF, 44 via alphaxiv.org markdown mirror); all 51 deep-read with validated paper notes and passing claim-support audits; 746 evidence events projected with prefix LR-FISHEYE-2026. Coverage/saturation gate: all six dimensions passed with two-round saturation convergence. All three reader-facing articles passed citation, trace-map, and editorial quality audits. Central findings: benefits stratify by whether task-critical information lies outside the pinhole view cone (beyond-FOV tasks move from 0/20 to usable, in-FOV gains compress to noise, dynamic clutter can turn wide FoV negative); costs are optical-level (15% pixel area, +166% monocular depth error at 195 deg FoV, 59-88% calibration failure at 240 deg); the methodological shift runs from image-space rectification to representation-space adaptation (FishRoPE polar position embeddings, calibration tokens, PE residuals at 10K-parameter scale).
